Description

Ionospheric observations, upper-atmosphere research, and Earth imaging. The mission is expected to provide valuable firsthand data for space weather monitoring, environmental change studies, and disaster research.

The mission focuses on technical self-training and aerospace education. It provides a V/U data Transponder for global amateur intercommunication and serves as a hands- on platform for university students to practice antenna tracking and digital decoding using the S-band downlink.
